pages.title: Server Config
pages.text: Gameplay settings live in the world serverconfig/firstworks-server.toml, with pack defaults under defaultconfigs. They synchronize to clients. Textile, masonry, grain, tool-binding, and primitive-copper switches control recipe replacements.

pages.title: Other Settings
pages.text: Rain collection, gathering chances, Quern work per crank, charcoal size, seal window, carbonization duration, and yields are configurable. This book gives defaults; the actual server settings take precedence.

pages.title: Client Config
pages.text: firstworks-client.toml contains loomInputAssistance and heatTemperatureUnit. Assistance removes repeated aiming while preserving loom timing; units convert temperature display without changing gameplay.

pages.title: Pack Content
pages.text: Public tags extend tools, bindings, fuels, heatable items, igniters, trees, gathering sources, and animals. Species profiles define materials. Datapack recipes define counts, timing, catalysts, priorities, forge actions, and outputs.
